# proposal-generator

**Trigger:** Draft a scoped client offer for review.

**Role:** Growth & Sales → Operations

**Required inputs:** Client brief, scope, deliverables, existing templates

**Tools:** Supplied proposal templates, project requirements when available and authorized.

**Procedure:** Define scope, deliverables, exclusions, milestones, client dependencies, test and handover criteria; label unapproved pricing as draft.

**Output:** Review-ready proposal.

**Success criterion:** No unapproved financial commitment or external sending.

**Mandatory:** Evidence, priority, next action, dependencies and definition of done. Never expose secrets. A skill does not execute independently. Any merge, deployment, production IAM or Firebase rule change, client communication or spending requires explicit additional founder approval.
